title: How to sell yourself as an engineering student! #engineering #engineeringstudent #cv #resumetips
transcript: You have to sell yourself. Your CV's very important. Unfortunately, this is the game. Don't make your CV look like a coloring book. Black and white, one page, simple text. Display what you've done. Add links to what you've done. If you like software engineering, link to your GitHub repo. If you're a mechanical engineer and you've done some cool stuff, link to your website, link to a project, link to something. Just showcase your stuff.
